en-GB.title: Praetorium.gg
en-GB.subtitle: Army lists and battle tracker
en-GB.description:
Build Warhammer 40,000 armies and track games from setup to final score.

Choose your faction, units and loadouts, check points as you build, and save or share your lists. Start 1v1, 2v1 or 2v2 games with friends, or practise on your own. Choose a mission and terrain, then track turns, command points, scoring, casualties and battle history.

Use Praetorium on the web, iPhone or Android. Share battle and roster links, print lists, get battle-action haptics and keep the screen awake while you play.

Praetorium is an unofficial product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Games Workshop. Warhammer 40,000 and related marks belong to Games Workshop.
